meta.title: Reject both bids
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the RFQ scenario.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where both submitted bids can be rejected.

args.goal: Reject Vendor A with a reason and then reject Vendor B with a reason; stop on the Responses screen showing both bids rejected

steps.note: Reject both bids using the buyer-side controls and provide the required rejection reasons.
Open the stage menu's Rejected Bids view.
Verify Vendor A appears in the rejected-bids list.
Verify Vendor B appears in the rejected-bids list.
Return to Master QCS to verify that no bid remains rankable.
Assert that Master QCS has no active bids to rank.

args.because: Please award for at least one Vendor

steps.note: Verify awarding cannot proceed when both bids have been rejected.
